title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 034
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute download and upload variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Downward arrow entering an open tray frame with two vertical side lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a download arrow entering a framed tray or inbox shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain shelf or cloud downloads when the side tray walls matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the arrow dropping into a tray with two vertical side walls.

items.depicts_observation: Downward arrow landing on a simple shelf line with short side posts
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most minimal downward arrow landing on a simple shelf.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tray or cloud downloads when the base should stay as a flat shelf line.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the tray walls and leaves only a short shelf under the arrow.

items.depicts_observation: Downward arrow centered inside a cloud outline with an open lower curve
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants downloading shown inside a cloud rather than a tray or shelf.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tray or shelf icons when the outer cloud outline must be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps the downward arrow inside a cloud outline instead of a boxy tray.

items.depicts_observation: Upward arrow rising from an open tray frame with two vertical side lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an upload arrow emerging from a framed tray shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for shelf or cloud uploads when the tray walls should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot mirrors the tray download shape but flips the arrow upward.

items.depicts_observation: Upward arrow rising from a simple shelf line with short side posts
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest upward arrow leaving a short base shelf.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tray or cloud uploads when the base should stay as a flat shelf line.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps only the lower shelf line under the upward arrow and removes tray walls.
